A small negative drift still needs the full formula. <bookmark mark='b'/> At exactly zero drift the time is delta squared. <bookmark mark='c'/> For large positive S delta, the leading term is the exponential divided by two S squared. The smooth exact expression connects all three cases. No sharp classification of an unknown manager follows from a finite path.
54e207462e54.zh: 这是极限情形，不是只按符号分类。<bookmark mark='a'/>S德尔塔很负时，领先时间为德尔塔除S绝对值；很小的负漂移仍要完整公式。<bookmark mark='b'/>零漂移时，时间精确为德尔塔平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>S德尔塔很大且为正时，领先项是指数除二S平方。平滑精确式连接这些情况。有限路径不能给未知经理作明确技能分类。

0202142aaa86.en: The cached six thousand grid-monitored paths have stop times from about point zero eight to nineteen point nine five years; all are shown over zero to twenty without clipping the tail. <bookmark mark='a'/> The continuous known-parameter mean is 2.19 years. <bookmark mark='b'/> The cached mean is 2.48, median 1.76, and about 16 percent exceed twice the continuous mean. Grid monitoring delays detection; sampling variation also matters. This is a stopping-time histogram, not the exponential peak law, and we do not claim an exact exponential time distribution. The general simulation helper excludes nonstoppers from reported stop-time means, so other parameter choices require censoring review.
0202142aaa86.zh: 缓存六千条网格监控路径，停止时间约零点零八至十九点九五年，在零到二十范围全部展示，不裁剪尾部。<bookmark mark='a'/>连续已知参数均值为2.19年。<bookmark mark='b'/>缓存均值2.48，中位数1.76年，约百分之16超过连续均值两倍。网格延迟发现，抽样波动也重要。这是停止时间直方图，不是指数峰值律，也不声称时间精确指数分布。通用模拟均值排除未停止者，其他参数必须检查删失。

3d9861e84d4d.en: The unchanged simulation uses four thousand paths per grid. <bookmark mark='a'/> At S one and delta one, daily monitoring gives 2.70 years versus continuous mean 2.19. <bookmark mark='b'/> Combining daily and eighth-day grids using a chosen square-root-step extrapolation gives 2.20. The grids have independent seeds and there are no Monte Carlo error bars here. Extrapolation is heuristic, not a proven error bound; deviations are not uniformly tiny. Every selected fine-grid row stopped by its horizon, but the general helper omits survivors from its means. High drift or deep barriers can produce severe censoring.
3d9861e84d4d.zh: 未改模拟每个网格四千条路径。<bookmark mark='a'/>S一、德尔塔一时，日监控给2.70年，连续均值2.19。<bookmark mark='b'/>用指定步长平方根外推结合日和八分之一天网格，得2.20。两网格种子独立，没有蒙特卡洛误差棒。外推是启发式，不是已证误差界，各偏差不都很小。所选六条细网格行均在期限内停止；通用函数却从均值中排除幸存者。高漂移或深边界可能严重删失。

909a6105a9ef.en: These are simulated three-year stop frequencies, with all original six thousand paths retained in each probability denominator. <bookmark mark='a'/> At depth one, the S zero frequency is 95 percent and S one is 67 percent. <bookmark mark='b'/> At depth one point five they become 72 and 24 percent. To call these errors and power, specify for example a simple null S one, alternative S zero, and reject the null when stopped by three years. A deeper barrier lowers both rejection probabilities. It is not automatically a sharper test at equal significance.
909a6105a9ef.zh: 这是模拟三年停止频率，各概率分母保留原六千条路径。<bookmark mark='a'/>深度一时，S零频率百分之95，S一百分之67。<bookmark mark='b'/>深度一点五时，分别百分之72和24。若称错误率和功效，需如指定简单原假设S一、备择S零，三年内停止即拒绝。更深边界降低两者拒绝率，并不自动成为同显著性下更锐利检验。

b1335cbb46c2.en: Fix a simple null of S one, alternative S zero, and rejection on stopping within three years. <bookmark mark='a'/> Under that convention, firing under the null is type one error; retaining the alternative is type two error. <bookmark mark='b'/> A deeper barrier trades lower false rejection for lower power at the same deadline. An equal-significance comparison requires calibration, and unknown composite skill needs more work. <bookmark mark='c'/> Stop depth, volatility, horizon, costs and the decision objective all matter. A changed risk budget also changes the experiment; these frequencies alone do not establish an optimal live policy.
b1335cbb46c2.zh: 固定简单原假设S一、备择S零，三年内停止则拒绝。<bookmark mark='a'/>该约定下，原假设经理被停止为一类错误，备择经理被保留为二类错误。<bookmark mark='b'/>更深边界降低误拒，也在同一期限降低功效。同显著性比较需要校准，复合未知技能还需更多分析。<bookmark mark='c'/>停止深度、波动、期限、成本和目标都重要。改变风险预算也改变实验，这些频率不足以证明最优实盘政策。

c5ace93bd3d7.en: Under the known Brownian arithmetic-profit model, finite mean stopping time permits Wald's identity. <bookmark mark='a'/> Expected terminal profit equals mu times expected time. <bookmark mark='b'/> At S one and delta point five it is 0.36 annual-volatility units; <bookmark mark='c'/> at delta one point five, 8.04. These are stopped arithmetic profits before costs, not annual investor returns or a complete value objective. Deeper stops retain both favorable and unfavorable drifts longer; replacement, capital, risk and learning determine a platform's decision.
c5ace93bd3d7.zh: 已知布朗算术利润模型下，有限平均停止时间允许使用瓦尔德恒等式。<bookmark mark='a'/>平均终止利润等于缪乘平均时间。<bookmark mark='b'/>S一、德尔塔零点五时为0.36个年度波动单位；<bookmark mark='c'/>德尔塔一点五时为8.04。这些是扣费前的停止算术利润，不是年投资者回报或完整价值目标。深边界使好坏漂移都保留更久，替换、资本、风险与学习决定平台选择。

8d7e77bd4625.en: Where this sits. <bookmark mark='a'/> Howard Taylor and John Lehoczky solved the stopped-at-a-drawdown problem in the 1970s. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sanford Grossman and Zhongquan Zhou found how an investor who must never fall below a fraction of the peak should invest: Part eight's floor. <bookmark mark='c'/> And Malik Magdon-Ismail and co-authors computed the expected maximum drawdown over a fixed horizon, the other question a manager asks.
8d7e77bd4625.zh: 这个结果的位置。<bookmark mark='a'/>Howard Taylor和John Lehoczky在1970年代解决了在回撤处停止的问题。<bookmark mark='b'/>Sanford Grossman和Zhongquan Zhou找到了一个绝不能跌破高点一定比例的投资者应如何投资：第8部分的底线。<bookmark mark='c'/>Malik Magdon-Ismail和合作者计算了固定期限内的期望最大回撤，这是基金经理会问的另一个问题。

9374b6c8dc45.en: Three extensions lie beyond this derivation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Unknown skill requires a specified prior, observation model, objective and cost of waiting before optimizing a boundary. <bookmark mark='b'/> A manager who changes exposure in response to a stop changes the stochastic model and incentives. <bookmark mark='c'/> Dependent returns, regimes, jumps and implementation costs need their own analysis. This lesson solves none of these extensions and does not claim that every version is globally unsolved.
9374b6c8dc45.zh: 三个扩展超出本推导。<bookmark mark='a'/>技能未知时，要先指定先验、观测模型、目标和等待成本，才能优化边界。<bookmark mark='b'/>经理根据停止线改变敞口，会改变随机模型和激励。<bookmark mark='c'/>依赖收益、状态、跳跃和执行成本各需分析。本课不解这些扩展，也不声称每种版本在全球文献都未解。

482433330d68.en: Pause and predict. Under the known continuous Brownian arithmetic-profit model, annual Sharpe is one point five, volatility four percent and stop six percent of initial capital. Compute delta, expected time and expected terminal profit before costs.
482433330d68.zh: 暂停并预测。已知连续布朗算术利润模型中，年夏普一点五，年波动为初始资本百分之四，停止深度百分之六。求德尔塔、平均停止时间与扣费前平均终止利润。

04c2895980f5.en: Part thirty-four in fourteen lines. Six illustrative business models distinguish capital, customers and the claimed source of revenue. A loss-day count implies a mean-to-volatility ratio only under a specified distribution; it does not identify real trading skill. Reported firm statistics need consistent fees and denominators. The chosen platform simulation includes selection, exposure and payout rules, and is not calibrated evidence about a real firm. Review requires a search record, information clock, executable cash ledger and uncertainty. Independent limits and authority to halt are proposed controls, not a guaranteed operating system.
04c2895980f5.zh: 用十四行回顾第三十四部分。六类示例商业模式区分资本、客户和声称的收入来源。亏损计数只有指定分布才能映射为均值波动比，不识别真实技能。公司数字需要一致费用与分母。指定平台含选择、敞口和奖金规则，不是真实公司校准。复核需要搜索记录、信息时钟、可执行现金账本与不确定性。独立限额与停止权限是拟议控制，不是保证有效的操作系统。

f92704eb080a.en: Technology faces physical latency floors as well as routing and operational constraints. Surveillance requires context and evidence; high cancellation alone is not proof of manipulation. Interview calculations state their probability and capital assumptions. Founding stories are selected histories. The factor-stop exercise uses dependent research comparisons and a descriptive shuffle reference, without costs. The proposed firm checklist does not approve deployment. Finally, the Brownian drawdown theorem is exact for known constant parameters and continuous arithmetic profit; the exponential law concerns the peak, while grid stop times need separate monitoring and censoring qualifications.
f92704eb080a.zh: 技术面对物理延迟下界，也有路由和操作约束。监控需要背景与证据，撤单多不证明操纵。面试计算要说明概率和资本条件。创始故事是筛选后的历史。因子停止比较重用研究数据、存在依赖，打乱只是描述，未计成本。公司检查表不批准部署。最后，布朗回撤定理对已知常参数、连续算术利润精确成立；指数律针对峰值，网格停止时间还需监控与删失条件。

9e11ea5d428c.en: Six desk questions, with assumptions stated. A loss-day count maps to an implied ratio under a specified distribution; it cannot identify skill by itself. <bookmark mark='a'/> A known Brownian Sharpe-one process reaches a half-volatility continuous drawdown in about four point three months on average. <bookmark mark='b'/> A platform may use stops for risk and learning, but its simulation also changes exposure, replacement and compensation. It is not a calibrated universal skill test.
9e11ea5d428c.zh: 六个交易台问题，先说明条件。亏损计数仅在指定分布下映射为隐含比率，不能单独识别技能。<bookmark mark='a'/>已知夏普一布朗过程的半波动连续回撤平均约四点三个月触及。<bookmark mark='b'/>平台可能因风险和学习使用停止，但模拟同时改变敞口、替换和薪酬，不是普遍校准的技能检验。

7002db5f4e66.en: Netting risk means paying positive pods while investors also bear the losers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Pre-trade limits and a tested halt mechanism are controls intended to constrain malfunction; their effectiveness is not a guaranteed counterfactual. <bookmark mark='b'/> A high cancellation rate alone does not establish spoofing. Placement, cancellation, opposite-side fills, context and communications may support investigation, with legal conclusions requiring more evidence.
7002db5f4e66.zh: 抵销风险是向正利润团队付费，同时投资者承担亏损团队。<bookmark mark='a'/>交易前限额和测试过的停止机制旨在约束故障，效果不是保证成立的反事实。<bookmark mark='b'/>高撤单率单独不证明虚假报单。位置、撤回、对侧成交、背景和通讯可能支持调查，法律结论还需更多证据。

4e2674933c3a.en: The chapter pause answers use their stated inputs. At ten percent gross, the simple fee formulas leave 6.4 and 3.2 percent; the separate problem-set question uses fifteen percent gross. <bookmark mark='a'/> Five losses in twelve hundred and fifty maps to Gaussian daily ratio 2.65; annualization to about 42 also needs iid variance assumptions. <bookmark mark='b'/> For two pods with capital one hundred each, profits plus ten and minus ten cancel. A twenty-percent positive-profit bonus is two currency units. Investors lose two, or one percent of two hundred. Bonus divided by zero gross profit is undefined.
4e2674933c3a.zh: 章节暂停题按各自输入作答。毛回报百分之十时，简单费用式留下百分之6.4和3.2；另一个习题用百分之十五。<bookmark mark='a'/>一千二百五十天五次亏损映射为正态日比率2.65，年化约42还需独立稳定方差。<bookmark mark='b'/>两队各一百资本，赚十和亏十抵消，正利润百分之二十奖金为两个货币单位。投资者亏二，占两百资本百分之一。奖金除零毛利润没有定义。

3dc685bbcd9b.en: In the chosen Gaussian likelihood with prior standard deviation one half and observed Sharpe two, posterior means are point four after one year and one after four. <bookmark mark='a'/> At fixed position and participation, halved daily volume doubles exit days; doubled volatility doubles the stipulated daily clip cost. Holding child size fixed would give a different answer. <bookmark mark='b'/> A three-millisecond advantage captures the edge only under a chosen first-arrival competition model. Half a basis point times captured notional gives gross value; costs, opponents, reliability and fill probability are still needed.
3dc685bbcd9b.zh: 指定正态似然、先验标准差二分之一、观测夏普二，后验均值一年后零点四，四年后一。<bookmark mark='a'/>固定持仓和参与率，日成交减半使退出天数翻倍；波动翻倍使指定日子单成本翻倍。固定子单数量则答案不同。<bookmark mark='b'/>三毫秒优势只有在指定先到竞争模型中捕获收益。半基点乘捕获名义金额给毛价值，还需要成本、对手、可靠性与成交概率。

0349ab343bcd.en: Cancellation alone does not establish intent; investigate the complete context. <bookmark mark='a'/> With fair dice, reroll one, two or three and retain four, five or six: expectation 4.25. Independent annual survival at one half gives expected survivors 0.9766, without guaranteeing one or demonstrating skill. <bookmark mark='b'/> The low-mean iid exposure approximation gives 0.52; the exact marginal formula includes the extra variance term. Under known continuous Brownian assumptions, S one point five and delta one point five give about 18.78 years; expected arithmetic profit is mu times that mean time.
0349ab343bcd.zh: 撤单本身不证明意图，需要完整背景。<bookmark mark='a'/>公平骰子中一二三重掷，四五六保留，期望4.25。每年独立以二分之一存活，期望幸存者0.9766，不保证一家，也不证明技能。<bookmark mark='b'/>独立同分布低均值仓位近似给0.52，精确边际式还有额外方差项。已知连续布朗条件下，S一点五、德尔塔一点五约18.78年，平均算术利润为缪乘该时间。

a2d05f6d96ed.en: Six basic problems state their inputs: the Gaussian loss-frequency calculation, one-period fees, two-pod capital accounting, the chosen Normal posterior, liquidity at fixed participation and a fair-die reroll. Derive each result and state its limits. Full solutions in English and Chinese are in the notes.
a2d05f6d96ed.zh: 六道基础题明确输入：正态亏损频率、单期费用、双团队资本记账、指定正态后验、固定参与率流动性与公平骰子重掷。推导结果并说明限制，完整中英文解答见说明文档。

b8c78a3844df.en: Four advanced problems extend the calculation: the maximum of two K-sided dice, the complete tail of a capped St. Petersburg game, Kelly and asymptotic log growth, and the exact marginal ratio under predictable iid exposure. Specify the probability model before interpreting the answer.
b8c78a3844df.zh: 四道进阶题扩展计算：两颗K面骰子最大值、封顶圣彼得堡完整尾部、凯利与渐近对数增长、可预测独立同分布仓位的精确边际比率。解释答案前先说明概率模型。

0941a759d2ea.en: Two qualifying problems prove the finite-mean reflected drawdown formula and the exponential peak law. The first must justify finiteness before identifying the candidate solution. The second must handle the moving boundary and justify Wald's identity. State continuity, known parameters, positive volatility and positive barrier throughout.
0941a759d2ea.zh: 两道资格题证明有限均值反射回撤公式与指数峰值律。第一题须先证明有限性，再识别候选解；第二题须处理移动边界并论证瓦尔德恒等式。全程说明连续性、已知参数、正波动与正边界。

d1c5e5a3d45b.en: Where this comes back. Part thirty-five maps who trades with whom. Part thirty-seven measures what a trade costs. Part thirty-eight is market making, the theory behind the dice game. And Part forty-one returns to regulation and crises.
d1c5e5a3d45b.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再次出现。第35部分描绘谁与谁交易。第37部分测量一笔交易的成本。第38部分是做市，骰子游戏背后的理论。第41部分回到监管与危机。

31daeae54e72.en: References distinguish mathematical sources, dated filings and legal records, books and attributed press reports. The numerical panels use the five unchanged verified ordinary calculations or explicit stipulated arithmetic. Historical quotations retain their source and date; this review does not independently verify current firm statistics or subsequent legal outcomes. No sealed strategy outcome is used.
31daeae54e72.zh: 参考资料区分数学来源、带日期的申报和法律记录、书籍及署名报道。数值面板来自五个未改且已验证的普通计算，或明确指定算术。历史引述保留来源和日期，本次不独立验证当前公司数字或后续法律结果，不使用封存策略结果。

f334d82f9b66.en: The House now has a proposed firm-level checklist: independent limits, authority to halt, explicit accounting and records of the search. A chart and numerical functions do not create an operating trading or compliance system. <bookmark mark='a'/> Next is market microstructure. Part thirty-five studies who trades with whom, through which venues, and which order and information assumptions determine costs.
f334d82f9b66.zh: 教学公司现在有拟议的公司检查标准：独立限额、停止权限、明确记账和搜索记录。图示与数值函数不创建运行中的交易或合规系统。<bookmark mark='a'/>接下来是市场微观结构。第三十五部分研究谁与谁交易、经过什么场所，以及哪些订单与信息假设决定成本。

3da87e6cb2a1.en: What a review asks, collected from this series. <bookmark mark='a'/> How many trials did it take to find? <bookmark mark='b'/> Is it after costs, at the size the firm would run it? <bookmark mark='c'/> Why should it work, and who pays? <bookmark mark='d'/> And what does it add to what the firm already holds? A strategy can pass the first three and still be rejected for the last.
3da87e6cb2a1.zh: 审查要问什么，从本系列中汇总。<bookmark mark='a'/>找到它用了多少次试验？<bookmark mark='b'/>它是否在扣除成本之后、在公司实际运行的规模上成立？<bookmark mark='c'/>它为什么应该有效，谁在付钱？<bookmark mark='d'/>它给公司已持有的东西增加了什么？一个策略可能通过前三项，却因最后一项被拒绝。
